visual_task: Three fixed museum candidates; text-only, header-only and body-integrated images
image_model_exception: Preregistered Luna high because direct image reading is required

composition.observation: Five balanced family panels form a clear, consistent classification grid with a useful reading-connections box.

image_usefulness.observation: No explanatory or recognizable images are present in the poster body.

image_integration.observation: There are no images to connect to branches, codes, or explanations.

playful_discovery.observation: The clean color system supports scanning, but the only invitation is a generic reading note and there are no specific prompts.

legibility.observation: Names, codes, indentation, connectors, and family descriptions are visibly crisp and easy to follow.

composition.observation: The same stable five-panel classification layout remains orderly and easy to scan.

image_usefulness.observation: The header kalimba is recognizable, but it does not visibly explain a category or mechanism.

image_integration.observation: The single image is isolated in the masthead with no label, branch connection, or code reference.

playful_discovery.observation: The small header image adds slight character, but there are no family-specific questions or comparison activities.

legibility.observation: The taxonomy, labels, connectors, and explanatory note remain visibly clear.

composition.observation: Each family gets a coherent taxonomy area plus a reserved example column, with a compact, energetic overall page.

image_usefulness.observation: Recognizable instruments visibly exemplify categories across all five families, including bell, kalimba, drums, winds, strings, electronics, and software.

image_integration.observation: Images sit inside their family panels and use readable `Example → code` labels to connect back to the classification.

playful_discovery.observation: Color-coded questions such as “STRIKE OR PLUCK?” and “WHY IS A KAZOO HERE?” provide concrete paths for comparison and discovery.

legibility.observation: The branch lines, codes, names, image captions, and explanatory note remain readable despite the added illustration columns.

composition.observation: Five clearly bounded family panels form a stable two-column classification composition with consistent branch routing.

image_usefulness.observation: No recognizable explanatory images appear anywhere in the poster body.

image_integration.observation: There is no artwork to connect to a category, branch, or mechanism.

playful_discovery.observation: The connection-reading box orients the reader, but offers no specific visual or question-led invitation to explore.

legibility.observation: Large dark labels, restrained colors, indentation, and generous panel spacing make the hierarchy easy to scan.

composition.observation: The underlying two-column panel structure is orderly, but the isolated header photograph reads as an orphaned visual accent.

image_usefulness.observation: A single small kalimba photograph identifies the subject but does not explain any visible family or branch.

image_integration.observation: The header image has no caption, code, connector, or panel ownership.

playful_discovery.observation: The poster remains a text reference sheet; the lone image does not create a path for comparison or discovery.

legibility.observation: The classification labels and branch lines retain strong contrast and comfortable spacing.

composition.observation: Family panels retain the clear tree structure while integrated right-hand image rails create a balanced second reading path.

image_usefulness.observation: Recognizable instruments are visibly paired with family content and example codes; they are useful exemplars, though not literal mechanism cutaways.

image_integration.observation: Each rail sits inside its panel, uses a divider, and pairs every pictured object with a name and explicit Example-to-code caption.

playful_discovery.observation: Specific prompts such as STRIKE OR PLUCK?, WHY IS A KAZOO HERE?, and WHERE IS THE SIGNAL? invite comparison and tracing.

legibility.observation: The full view and detail crops show readable labels, codes, captions, and branch lines with clear separation from the artwork.

composition.observation: Five color-coded panels form a balanced two-column composition with a clear footer explanation and orderly indented branches.

image_usefulness.observation: No recognizable explanatory images appear in the poster or diagram.

image_integration.observation: There is no image layer to connect to a family, branch, code, or explanatory claim.

playful_discovery.observation: The title and connection note orient the reader, but there is no visitor prompt, challenge, or visual discovery hook.

legibility.observation: High-contrast type, generous spacing, and consistent routing make the family names, codes, and labels easy to scan.

composition.observation: The underlying five-panel composition remains balanced and readable; the small header image does not disrupt the hierarchy.

image_usefulness.observation: A single small kalimba is recognizable, but it supplies no useful comparison across families and does not teach a branch relationship.

image_integration.observation: The kalimba floats in the header rather than sitting by its relevant category or code, so its connection to the diagram is unresolved.

playful_discovery.observation: The image adds a small decorative hook, but the poster still has no specific question, invitation, or visual exploration route.

legibility.observation: The tree labels, codes, and explanatory note remain as clear as in p, with strong contrast and consistent spacing.

composition.observation: Each family panel has a repeatable tree-plus-image-gutter structure, while the header, reading note, and footer maintain a coherent page hierarchy.

image_usefulness.observation: Multiple recognizable instruments and sound tools show concrete examples for the branches, including mapped examples for idiophones, chordophones, membranophones, aerophones, and electrophones.

image_integration.observation: Images are placed inside the corresponding family panels and paired with visible names and `Example → code` captions rather than being isolated decoration.

playful_discovery.observation: The subtitle gives a route through the chart and each panel’s question prompt encourages visitors to compare how sound is produced.

legibility.observation: The main tree remains readable and high-contrast, though the smaller example captions and denser image gutters require more careful viewing than p or q.

limits: One development discrimination task repeated three times, not a held-out broad-domain production benchmark.

Final instrument captions incorporate optional visual criticism after the input freeze.
